question: Who among the following sang the famous Bollywood song "Ae Dil Hai Mushkil"?
solution:
The correct answer is __Arijit Singh__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The song "Ae Dil Hai Mushkil" is from the 2016 Indian film "Ae Dil Hai Mushkil" directed by Karan Johar.
 
• The music for the song is composed by Pritam and the lyrics are written by Amitabh Bhattacharya.
 
• The song is sung by Arijit Singh, who is a popular and versatile playback singer in Bollywood.
 
• Arijit Singh has won several awards for his contributions to Indian music and is known for his soulful renditions.
 
• "Channa Mereya" has become an all-time favourite among Bollywood music lovers and has earned Singh widespread acclaim.
